implementation.summary: D36 audited the existing P14 deployment path and bound it to an exact clean candidate. No production code change was justified: the Compose, migration, worker, health, appliance backup and recovery implementation already exercised the planned cell. The campaign added no claim beyond the real evidence recorded here.

security_and_recovery.journey: The real journey starts Compose services, reaches health, validates and plans the frozen v0.1 path, executes worker cells, exercises lease expiry/restart/reclaim, replay/idempotency and cancellation, then restores PostgreSQL rows and /var/lib/ronin artifacts/evidence from an appliance bundle after destructive mutation.
security_and_recovery.negative_paths: Candidate contracts cover rejected Compose exposure, malformed/unsafe backup manifests, invalid migration states, backup checksum/inventory barriers and Docker qualification fail-closed rules; the real journey covers killed workers, orphaned leases, replay and cancellation.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: The real Docker run used PostgreSQL 16.4, the repository Floci S3 profile and Azurite Blob profile. It does not certify external object storage, Kubernetes/Helm, multi-node HA or a supported-platform matrix.
